name: Blitzclique Overvolt
effectText: Target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Blitzclique Overvolt" once per turn.
